# Clean Skill

## Purpose

Formats diagrams.

## Workflow

1. Read the diagram source.
2. Propose a tidied layout to the user.

## Output Format

A tidied diagram plus a one-line summary of the layout rules applied.

## Validation Checklist

- [ ] Layout rules listed.
